title: BasketQuake
wikitext:
BasketQuake is a mod for QuakeWorld by [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[Phil]].  It tries to introduce basketball rules into the Quake paradigm.  It is still riddled with bugs, which will be fixed soon :)

You can download the mod [http://qw.quakephil.com/bball/ here]!

Development may resume if people are interested.

* You can only hurt and/or bounce the one player who currently has posession of the ball.
* You can steal the ball by midairing your opponent, or by killing him.
* Points ("frags") are scored only by shooting the basketball (using the Grenade Launcher).
* Basketball can be shot with varying speed (by holding down the attack button), or passed in a straight line like a rocket.
* Includes announcer voice from NBA Jam!!!1111oneoneeleventy
